media.altText: Illustrated magazine page headed “This New Age”, including two men seated with sheet music and the printed caption naming Herbert Stothart and Ramon Novarro.
media.description: The upper-right photograph is captioned “Herbert Stothart, right, goes over a new song with Ramon Novarro, who sings several numbers in ‘Devil May Care.’” This record preserves the complete printed page and its caption. The earlier claim that the caption reverses the sitters has not been independently documented; no positional correction is asserted here.
media.publicCaption: Herbert Stothart and Ramon Novarro, as named in the original caption, going over a song for Devil May Care. Complete illustrated page “This New Age”, Picture Play Magazine, 1930, p. 97.
media.publicCreditLine: Photographer unidentified; Picture Play Magazine, vol. 31–32 (January–June 1930), p. 97; digitised by the Media History Digital Library from the copy in the Museum of Modern Art Library, New York.
media.rightsNote: Public domain in the United States. The illustrated page was published in Picture Play Magazine in the first half of 1930, before 1 January 1931, so United States copyright has expired. No photographer is credited for the Stothart–Novarro photograph. The image may remain protected in jurisdictions that do not apply the rule of the shorter term to United States works.
